correctness.rationale: Factor the Fourier transform as product (1+exp(-2pi i at)), etc. Its zeros are three pairwise disjoint odd half-lattices; two edges with the same color at a vertex yield an even-integral difference that is in none, so every orthogonality clique is properly 3-edge-colored. Every triangle must use all three colors and gives odd xA-yB-zC=0; a unique primitive integer relation permits such odd coefficients iff all entries odd. K4 uniquely 3-edge-colors by opposite-edge matchings, and comparing integer multiples of the same rank-two primitive relation in its 3 triangles forces k=l=-k=0, contradicting odd edge coefficients. The rank-three case precludes triangles. For A=1+sqrt2, B=sqrt2, C=1, relation A-B-C=0; a=-1+sqrt2,b=sqrt2/2,c=1 yield 8 distinct subset sums by coefficient comparison over Q(sqrt2). Checker computes only that witness, not all families. No assumptions on irrationality have been omitted.

final_claim: For the convolution of three equal-mass two-point measures at lengths a,b,c>0 with pairwise irrational ratios, maximum size of an orthogonal exponential family is 2 in reciprocal rational rank 3 or when its unique primitive integer relation is not odd in all three positions, and 3 exactly when the rank is 2 and all primitive coordinates are odd; any triple has the explicitly classified half-lattice form and no four exist. A=(1+sqrt2),B=sqrt2,C=1 yields an eight-distinct-atom size-3 witness.
